::: {#def-effective-parameters}
#### Effective number of parameters

Let $\overline{D} \eqdef \E{D(\vth) \mid \vy}$ be the posterior mean of the [deviance](#def-bayes-deviance),
and let $\bar{\vth} \eqdef \E{\vth \mid \vy}$ be the posterior mean of the parameters.
The **effective number of parameters** is

$$
p_D \eqdef \overline{D} - D(\bar{\vth}).
$$
:::
